items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Johnny was one of the first guys to come up and see me, but he didn't have anything to do with the booking.

ctx.x: I organized the band and I'm trying to remember who it was that booked me in there--
No. Johnny was one of the first guys to come up and see me, but he didn't have anything to do with the booking.
